description: Mint a new verified booking code on 1 to 6 target bookmakers from either a plan_id (from mbc_resolve_picks) or direct picks. Costs 2 credits per target code created; refunded if no code is created.

accept_odds_change.description: Allow booking if odds moved since resolution (default false).

bookmaker.description: Primary target bookmaker key or alias (e.g. 'sportybet').

picks.description: Direct game picks when booking without a plan_id.

strict.description: All games must resolve or no code is created (default true).

to.description: Optional fan-out list of 1 to 6 target bookmakers.

name: mbc_book_code
title: Book a New Bet Code From Plan or Picks
